preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.intro: How Polaris looks for your account, and the units and formats it writes in.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Applies right away, in every open tab.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: Applied the moment it is saved, on every screen.

descriptions.dark: The default. Quiet surfaces with a trace of blue in them.
descriptions.light: White surfaces, for a bright room.
descriptions.system: Dark or light, whichever this machine is set to.
descriptions.midnight: Nearly black, with the panels further apart. For a dark room.
descriptions.graphite: Grey with no colour cast, for anyone the blue tint bothers.

weekStart.label: Week starts on
weekStart.hint: Where every calendar and week view begins.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.hint: Every time on screen is written in it. Automatic follows the device you are on.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Polaris is laid out in this size, so the rows and panels around the text grow with it. The page changes as you move the slider; it stays that way once you save.
accessibility.defaultIs: The default here is {size}px. <back>Go back to it</back>

spoilers.title: Show spoilers without asking
spoilers.body: Pictures and messages somebody sent covered are drawn straight away instead of waiting for a press. This browser only.

deviceCache.title: This device
deviceCache.body: Polaris keeps a few things in this browser so screens open faster - pictures, how loud each person is in a call, playback speed. Clear them if something looks out of date and a reload has not fixed it. Your other devices are not affected, and you stay signed in.

apps.title: Polaris as an app
apps.body: Open Polaris in its own window, install the desktop app, or add the browser extension.

errors.statusNotSaved: That status could not be saved

page.title: Access rules
page.intro: Restrict where your account and your API keys may be used from.

page.title: Activity
page.intro: What has been done with your account, and which device did it.

page.title: API keys
page.intro: Credentials for scripts and integrations acting as you. Keep them somewhere safe: anyone holding one can do what it allows, as you.

page.title: Connected accounts
page.intro: The outside accounts Polaris acts with on your behalf. Only yours, and only what you link.

page.title: Account
page.intro: How you sign in and how Polaris reaches you. None of it is on your profile.

page.title: Voice & Video
page.intro: Which microphone and camera Polaris uses on this machine, and how you sound through them. Kept in this browser, because a headset is plugged into a machine rather than into an account.

mic.title: Microphone
mic.pressTest: Press Test it to see what is here
mic.namesHint: The names only appear once a microphone has been allowed once, which the test does.
mic.saySomething: Say something. The bars should move.
mic.watchBars: Talk and watch the bars. If they stay dark, press Test it.
mic.unfiltered: It could not start, so you are going out unfiltered: {problem}
mic.runningNoModel: Running, with no model - only the volume above.
mic.volumeHint: How loud you go out. Turn it up if people say you are quiet.

camera.title: Camera
camera.pressShow: Press Show me to see what is here
camera.closed: Nothing is opened until you press it, and it closes when you leave this screen.
camera.inCall: This is the camera your call is sending, background and all.
camera.ownPicture: Use a picture of your own
camera.pictureStays: A picture of your own stays in this browser and is sent nowhere.
camera.pictureFailed: Polaris could not use that picture.
camera.starting: Starting. The first one on a machine downloads the model.
camera.failed: It could not start, so there is nothing behind you: {problem}
camera.running: Running. This is what a call sends.

input.title: Input
input.keyHint: Held down to talk. It stands down while you are typing.
input.thresholdHint: Test the microphone above while you set this: the mark on the bar is where it opens, and the bar turns green past it.
input.releaseHint: Zero cuts the last syllable off, and everybody hears it.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.intro: Leave these alone unless something is wrong. Each one is set to what Polaris did before this screen existed.

autoGain.label: Automatic gain control
autoGain.note: Lets the browser even out how loud you are. Turn it off if your level is pumped up and down between sentences.

betterDetection.label: Better voice detection
betterDetection.note: Decides whether you are talking from the cleaned-up sound rather than the raw microphone, so a keyboard or a fan does not open it. Costs whatever the noise model costs.

bypass.label: Send the microphone untouched
bypass.note: Turns off the browser's echo, noise and level handling together, for an interface or a feed that has already done all three. Doing it twice is what ruins that sound.

noAudio.label: Say when nothing is picked up
noAudio.note: A microphone that opened but hears nothing looks exactly like somebody who is not talking. This is the only thing that would tell you.

switchWarning.label: Ask before switching rooms mid-call
switchWarning.note: Joining another voice room hangs up the call you are in. Off by default, because most of the time that is what pressing it meant.

attenuate.label: Quieten the call while you talk
attenuate.note: Turns the room down while your microphone is open. It is Polaris's own sound, not the machine's - a page cannot reach your other applications.

advanced.howFarLabel: How far the call is quietened
advanced.howFarHint: A hundred is silence while you are speaking.
advanced.stream: Lower voices while a stream plays
advanced.streamLabel: How far voices are lowered while a stream plays
advanced.streamHint: While you watch a stream that has sound. Zero leaves voices alone.
